figures.caption: GRASP architecture from public filing data to company and sector outputs.
Core database relationships. A company has multiple filings, and each filing has multiple context-bearing facts.
Read-only company analysis request from browser selection to a source-linked response.
Single-label dataset construction from narrative facts, recorded label sources and company-based splitting.
Live company search locates matching names and CINs before opening a filing report.
Live filing report for Triveni Turbine Limited, showing company identity, reporting year and filed numerical trends.
Peer-comparison selection with two financial companies. The interface supports a group of two to five companies.
Structured filing upload screen. The implemented route accepts XML/XBRL files; no file was uploaded for this documentation capture.
Validation macro-F1 over five completed epochs. The highest recorded value occurs at epoch 4, which supplies the selected checkpoint.
Top-1 agreement by label source with reported company-bootstrap confidence intervals.
Mean Transparency Scores for selected eligible sectors. Group sizes are shown with the names; bars describe saved company scores rather than environmental performance.
